description: Header file defining interface and constants for FXAS21002 gyroscope sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register addresses, enums, data structures, and function prototypes.

methods.name: fxas21002_get_power
methods.description: Get current power state of the FXAS21002 sensor.

methods.name: fxas21002_set_power
methods.description: Set power state of the FXAS21002 sensor.

methods.name: fxas21002_get_transition_time
methods.description: Calculate transition time between power states based on data rate.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_write_spi
methods.description: Write a byte to the sensor register via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_read_spi
methods.description: Read a byte from the sensor register via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_reg_field_update_spi
methods.description: Update specific register field via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_read_spi
methods.description: Read multiple bytes from sensor via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_write_i2c
methods.description: Write a byte to the sensor register via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_read_i2c
methods.description: Read a byte from the sensor register via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_reg_field_update_i2c
methods.description: Update specific register field via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_read_i2c
methods.description: Read multiple bytes from sensor via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_trigger_set
methods.description: Set trigger handler for FXAS21002 sensor.
